responsesToPartnerChallenges.partnerPoint: Displayed-pose continuity matters more than a raw-engine-only check.

responsesToPartnerChallenges.evidenceBasedResolution: signature.js carries the difference between rendered and raw pose on replay; browser replay exact=true and frozen resize records check the visible state. Dedicated tests cover cached layout and stopped reduced-motion scheduling. These show that the controller preserves a frozen frame and begins replay from the current display. They do not certify that a person experiences the entire retarget as smooth.

The native larger-view choice remains useful. Do not make the mitten the sole invitation cue, assume visitors find enlargement, change anatomy or declare Both defective without an observed task.
